name: Sacred Teaching
raw_text: Available with all weapons Type Passive Neutral Description Grants temporary HP exceeding your MaxHP when recovering with a Heal-type skill( * ). ATK and MATK will slightly increase according to the value of temporary HP gained. All Weapons ( * )If the total HP (MaxHP + temporary HP) exceeds the 99,999 HP limit, the number of temporary HP gained will be reduced. Holy Fist
